ul.li: The Google Sheets flow is deliberately one-way. The only return arrow carries acknowledgements and errors — never ticket data. This is FR-22, and it is the single most important constraint on the diagram: the moment data flows back, you own a conflict-resolution problem the SRS has no rule for.

Employee sits outside the boundary. They have no login and exchange no data with the system. The concern reaches the system only after IT Staff encodes it. The dashed arrow is context, not a system flow.
IT Staff also reads the sheet directly (dashed) — this is a human reading a Google tab, not a system interface, but it is why FR-25 exists.
